articles.title: FMC Corporation Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results and Revised Fourth-Quarter Outlook

articles.summary: Third-quarter revenue1 is now expected to be $65 million to $125 million, with Adjusted EBITDA2 expected to be negative $565 million to negative $510 million Revised expectations now include commercial actions which are resulting in approximately $625 million to $675 million in charges impacting revenue1 and Adjusted EBITDA2
articles.title: FMC Corporation Provides Update to Third-Quarter Expectations and Announces Comprehensive Commercial Actions to Expedite Return to Growth
